title: Dodgers place Roki Sasaki on IL with blister on right middle finger; Eric Lauer expected to take rotation spot

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dodgers place Roki Sasaki on IL with blister on right middle finger; Eric Lauer expected to take rotation spot
sources.description: Sasaki goes on the IL as Tyler Glasnow and perhaps Shohei Ohtani rejoin the Dodgers' rotation. Eric Lauer is expected to take Sasaki's turn.
